evals.prompt: Review the changes in the latest commit and save a report
evals.expected_output: An overview (change scope, spec compliance, doc sync), MUST → SHOULD → CONSIDER findings, good points, and an overall verdict are written to output/reports/review/REVIEW_<target>.md without modifying source.
assertions: A file starting with REVIEW_ is created under output/reports/review/
Findings are grouped under MUST / SHOULD / CONSIDER headings, keeping empty headings
Each finding has file-path:line and a reason
At least one good point is listed
The overall verdict is exactly one of Approved / Conditionally Approved (After MUST Fixes) / Needs Revision

evals.prompt: review it, and fix every bug you find while you're at it
evals.expected_output: It reviews without modifying source code and points to /implementing-features or /review-fix for the fixes.
assertions: No source or test files are modified
It states that fixing is out of scope
